CustomField.description: BR-15, BR-16, PD-12. Who performed the acceptance, captured from the authenticated Salesforce identity at the moment of acceptance - never free text and never inferred. DELIBERATELY NOT OwnerId: ownership is who holds the record and can be reassigned afterwards, while acceptance is who took responsibility at a point in time. They often coincide; they are not the same business fact. Also not LastModifiedById, which any later edit overwrites.
